name: insightly-se-mcp-bridge-test
description: TESTING — full Insightly SE MCP served from Cloudflare Workers through a local bridge. Keys stay on this machine.
long_description: Experimental: the complete Insightly SE MCP (all 35 tools + the interactive dashboard) runs on a Cloudflare Worker; this tiny local bridge forwards each request and attaches your active environment's API key per request. Keys live ONLY in this machine's keystore (~/.insightly-mcp/keys.json — shared with the classic extension) and are never stored server-side. Environment switching/add/rename/remove run locally in the bridge. Installs ALONGSIDE the classic extension; disable one while testing the other (they expose the same tool names).

server_url.title: Remote MCP server URL
server_url.description: The Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint this bridge forwards to. Leave the default to test against the public spike (fake data).

uv_path.title: Path to uv
uv_path.description: macOS only — Windows finds uv on PATH automatically. Same value as your existing Insightly SE MCP extension. Apple Silicon + Homebrew default is prefilled; otherwise run `which uv` in Terminal.

api_key.title: Insightly API key (optional)
api_key.description: Optional. If set, this key becomes the active environment on startup. If you already use the classic extension's saved environments, leave this empty and just say 'switch to <env name>' in chat.

pod.title: Insightly pod
pod.description: Region for the optional key above: na1 (default), eu1, or ap1.

tools.name: env_dashboard
tools.description: Interactive dashboard served from the Cloudflare worker.

tools.name: env_summary
tools.description: Real record counts across core objects.

tools.name: newest_by
tools.description: Latest records by any date field without scanning the object.

tools.name: use_saved
tools.description: Switch environment by name (runs locally; key stays on this machine).
